section1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
section1.content: By accessing and using the Reps Counter application, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use.

section2.title: 2. Disclaimer of Liability and Advertisements
section2.content: Reps Counter is provided "as is" without any warranties. We are not responsible for any damages, health issues, or data loss resulting from the use of this application. Advertisements shown in the application are served by third parties (Google AdSense), and we are not responsible for their content. Use it at your own risk.

section3.title: 3. Data Storage and External Services
section3.content: Most of your workout and workout-related data is stored locally on your device. However, the app loads premium advertisement scripts from Google AdSense in order to fund and maintain the project.

section4.title: 4. Dispute Resolution
section4.content: Any disputes arising from the use of this application shall be resolved exclusively by the competent courts in Gdańsk, Poland.

section5.title: 5. Changes to Terms
section5.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the application constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

section1.title: 1. Data Collection
section1.content: Your fitness data, goals, and logs are not collected, processed or stored on any external servers by us. However, the application may collect or transmit anonymous technical data required to show advertisements and ensure correct page delivery.

section2.title: 2. Local Storage
section2.content: All workout logs, goals, and settings are stored locally in your device's memory (IndexedDB/LocalStorage). You have full control over your data.

section3.title: 3. Personalized Ads and Cookies (Google AdSense)
section3.content: This application displays advertisements served by Google AdSense. Google, as a third-party vendor, uses cookies to serve ads on this site. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to users based on their visit to this site and/or other sites on the Internet. Users may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings (adssettings.google.com) or by visiting www.aboutads.info.

section4.title: 4. Data Security and Isolation
section4.content: Your local data is protected by safe browser sandbox mechanisms. We recommend securing your physical device using passcodes or biometric scanners to protect your data.

section5.title: 5. Contact
section5.content: If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, or want to discuss details of your privacy, please contact us at kontakt@licznikpowtorzen.pl.
